_comment: Performance regression gate policy (Issue #572). The CI workflow .github/workflows/perf-regression.yml runs these benches on both the PR and main on the SAME runner and fails if any STRICT bench's Criterion median regresses by more than its threshold_pct. ADVISORY benches are always reported but never cause a non-zero exit, regardless of delta — they exist to document cost, not to block merges. To adjust, edit bench entries here; see cqlite-core/benches/README.md.
_comment_reconcile_overlap: issue #2043 (epic #2817 M9) — the 27 reconcile_overlap/* ids below are a MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT, registered advisory-only: they carry no threshold_pct and deliberately have NO entry in `benches`, so they can never fail (or be compared by) the gate. perf-regression.yml does not run the `reconcile_overlap` target at all; its numbers live in docs/research/issue-2043-reconcile-overlap-multiplier.md. NOTE (roborev, issue #2043): because check_perf_regression.py iterates `benches` only, these ids are INERT today — no consumer reads them. They are kept as a DECLARATIVE classification so that if this target is ever wired into perf-regression.yml it starts out advisory rather than strict; do not read their presence as live gate configuration.
